title: Iron axe

infobox.Hitbox: 2.2 range, 90 angle, 0.6 height, vertical, no multitarget penalty

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Iron axe is the fourth one-handed axe. It can be used to chop down Ancient, Birch, Beech, Fir, Oak and Pine trees.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a slow but powerful overhead swing. This is perfect for removing tree stumps that are too low to hit with a normal swing.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • In the game files, the iron axe is sometimes known as "Viking Axe."

Introduction. The Iron axe is the fourth one-handed axe. It can be used to chop down Ancient, Birch, Beech, Fir, Oak and Pine trees.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a slow but powerful overhead swing. This is perfect for removing tree stumps that are too low to hit with a normal swing.

Trivia. • In the game files, the iron axe is sometimes known as "Viking Axe."
